name: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad, MBA-PGPX (One Year MBA)

class_size.note: The audited placement report counts 156 students graduating in 2026.

tuition_total.note: Bundled fee for single student housing (SSH): tuition, books and course materials, accommodation, library/computing/network. INR 37.10 lakh with married student housing. Excludes the International Immersion Programme (IIP) cost and its travel and stay. 2024-25 fee was INR 33 lakh (SSH).

mandatory_fees_total.note: IIP cost charged separately (amount not on the page). Utilities (electricity, phone, laundry, gym) billed by usage. The IIMA payment portal lists a caution money of INR 35,000 for single accommodation (https://payments.iima.ac.in/online/pg/50, seen in search extract only).

living_budget_total.note: Accommodation is included in the programme fee; IIMA publishes no budget for food and personal expenses.

scholarship.note: Entry scholarships up to 25% of the SSH fee (underrepresented genders, non-Indian passport holders, armed forces, government/not-for-profit experience, etc.); graduation scholarships up to 15% of the SSH fee for performance. Number and average award not published.

employment.standard: IPRS Revision 2.2 (audited by B2K Analytics, 16 July 2026)

placement_pool.note: accepted_3m_pct = 134/139 who sought placement through the institute (our division); placement process ran Nov 2025 - June 2026, i.e. by graduation, not at 3 months. Opted out: 8 company-sponsored/already employed, 1 entrepreneurship, 1 family business, 7 seeking outside campus.

base_salary.definition: Fixed Yearly Cash Component, combined domestic + international (134 offers)

signing_bonus.note: One-time cash component, median INR 2,00,000 (mean 3,33,750) received in 88 of 134 accepted offers (our division).

by_industry_meta.basis: pct = offers accepted in sector / 134 (our division of the published counts); salary = median Fixed Yearly Cash Component, domestic offers only (INR). IT Consulting includes the 2 international offers (fixed USD 95,145).

by_function_meta.basis: pct = offers / 134; salary = median Fixed Yearly Cash Component, domestic offers (INR); Business Development count includes 2 international offers, its salary is the domestic median (7 offers).

by_geography_meta.basis: offers accepted by location / 134; salary = median Fixed Yearly Cash Component

employment.top_employers_note: IIMA: 'Accenture, Amazon, Eli Lilly, EY, FinIQ Consulting, Genpact and NTT data were the firms that made the highest number of offers' (counts not given). 200+ companies, 300+ offers, about 65 first-time recruiters.

profile.note: Average work experience given as a range '7-8 years'; 36% of students have international exposure (work or study), not the share of international students. Prior industries: IT products/IT & ITeS, manufacturing/engineering, BFSI and defence, consulting, energy, etc.

rankings_cited.note: Rank seen in a search extract of the IIMA rankings page.

notes: Report scanned (image PDF); tables read from rendered page images. Sector/function percentages are computed by us from published counts. All salaries are offer data audited under IPRS.
